No PUCT IA amendment, no Ch.313/JETI filing, no EIA-860M listing -- absence of ALL the paper trails that typically accompany active/near-construction projects (compare Hanson Solar dossier, which had 2 IA amendments + Ch313 + EIA all present pre-construction)

reasoning_evidence: The only legally binding COD on file with PUCT is the ORIGINAL IA's 2023-06-01 Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (sources/2026-07-19_puct_35077-1353_..., Exhibit B) -- three years stale. No amendment renegotiating this schedule exists anywhere in docket 35077 despite an exhaustive sweep (see contractual_schedule.note) even though the queue's self-reported COD has moved three times since (2023-06 -> 2024-06 -> 2025-05 -> 2027-06, timeline.md)

This pattern -- queue COD updates with no corresponding IA amendment on file -- differs from Hanson Solar (23INR0086), where each queue slip was backed by a filed, countersigned Amendment. Here the queue COD looks like a developer/ERCOT-administrative update UNBACKED by a renegotiated interconnection contract, a materially weaker basis for the claim

Positive reality signals do exist: $4.28M in real cash security was posted on schedule in 2022 (Exhibit E), and the project remains an active line item in queue reports through 2026-06-01 (not cancelled/inactive)

Negative reality signals: not in EIA-860M (eia_history.json), no Ch.313/JETI value-limitation filing, no Google Places delivery pin, no satellite-confirmed construction, and the opposition group's own tracker still says 'Est Build start: Summer 2026' (i.e. not started) as of this week

Given a 4-year total slip already, an un-amended contractual schedule, and zero independent confirmation of construction activity, the reported 2027-06-21 COD should be treated as a soft developer estimate, not a grounded contractual date. A defensible independent estimate widens the band past the reported date: if the Summer-2026 build-start estimate holds and a ~12-18mo solar build cadence applies (per playbook fuel-signature guidance), COD lands in the 2027-Q3-2028-Q2 range -- but this is a schedule-logic estimate, not an imagery-confirmed one

contractual_schedule.note: NO AMENDMENT ON FILE at PUCT despite 3 subsequent queue COD slips (2023-06 -> 2024-06 -> 2025-05 -> 2027-06). Exhaustive docket sweep (puct.py match INR-join + name-key; manual review of all 35 Rayburn-party filings in docket 35077; --match Caney/HEP; date-range grep) found only the single original 2022-01-03 filing. Other Rayburn projects (BT Signal Ranch, Sowers, Tanzanite, Amador) have 2-6 amendments each in the same docket over the same period -- the absence for Caney Creek is a real signal, not a search-tooling gap. The only legally binding schedule on file still says COD 2023-06-01, three years stale vs the queue's current 2027-06-21 claim.
